title: Metabolic reprogramming in pancreatic cancer: interplay of glucose, lipid, and amino acid metabolism in tumor progression.
snippet: Pancreatic cancer is one of the most malignant solid tumors, with a five-year survival rate of less than 10%. The therapeutic challenges primarily stem from difficulties in early diagnosis, high heterogeneity, and extensive resistance to chemotherapy, targeted therapy, and immunotherapy. title: A CTC/DTC-centered temporal framework of bone metastasis: From dissemination to dormancy and reactivation.
snippet: Bone metastasis is a major cause of morbidity and poor survival in solid tumors, yet its progression is often recognized only after overt lesion formation.
